namespace Aproda.Base;

codeunit 50900 "Translation Test Mgt"
{
    procedure ShowSingleParameterMessage(ItemNo: Code[20])
    begin
        Message(SingleParameterMsg, ItemNo);
    end;

    procedure ShowFourParameterMessage(ItemNo: Code[20]; Description: Text[100]; ResponsibleEmployee: Text[100]; PostingDate: Date)
    begin
        Message(FourParameterMsg, ItemNo, Description, ResponsibleEmployee, PostingDate);
    end;

    procedure GetDefaultResponsibleEmployee(): Text[100]
    begin
        // literal name incl. sharp-S ("ß") for translation/encoding testing
        exit(DefaultResponsibleEmployeeTxt);
    end;

    procedure ShowCustomerNotFoundAgain(CustomerNo: Code[20])
    begin
        // second wave: reuses the exact source + context class (Codeunit|NamedType|Label)
        // of CustomerNotFoundErr below, which is approved by the time stage 1 runs
        Message(CustomerNotFoundAltErr, CustomerNo);
    end;

    var
        SingleParameterMsg: Label 'Translation test for item %1.', Comment = '%1 = Item No.';
        FourParameterMsg: Label 'Item %1 (%2), responsible: %3, posting date: %4.', Comment = '%1 = Item No.; %2 = Description; %3 = Responsible Employee; %4 = Posting Date';
        DefaultResponsibleEmployeeTxt: Label 'Hans Maßrichter';
        // must NOT appear in the generated XLIFF
        TechnicalKeyTok: Label 'ItemNo=%1;Qty=%2', Locked = true;
        // XML-significant characters must survive escaping and the round trip
        SpecialCharsQst: Label 'Save & close "%1" <draft>?', Comment = '%1 = Document No.';
        // classic dialog placeholder style
        ProgressMsg: Label 'Processing item    #1##########';
        // no letters at all: nothing to translate, target must equal source
        RatioTok: Label '%1 / %2', Comment = '%1 = Numerator; %2 = Denominator';
        // same domain term in two labels: terminology must stay consistent
        DeliveryNoteCreatedMsg: Label 'The delivery note for %1 was created.', Comment = '%1 = Customer Name';
        DeliveryNotePrintErr: Label 'The delivery note could not be printed.';
        // length-constrained caption
        ShortQuantityTxt: Label 'Qty.', MaxLength = 10;
        // same source as the table field "Release" and the page action "Release";
        // completes the three-way cross-context-class ambiguity set (§4.2)
        ReleaseStatusTxt: Label 'Release';
        // near-duplicate of SingleParameterMsg with one extra placeholder: same
        // normalised wording, different placeholder signature - must not tier-2-match,
        // and is fuzzy-tier-3 context for the other
        SingleParameterAltMsg: Label 'Translation test for item %1 and %2.', Comment = '%1 = Item No.; %2 = Second Item No.';
        // the architecture's own canonical fuzzy pair (§4.3): identical modulo the
        // placeholder index, recognised as near-identical only after placeholder masking
        PostedRatioMsg: Label 'Posted %1 of %2.', Comment = '%1 = Current; %2 = Total';
        PostedRatioAltMsg: Label 'Posted %1 of %3.', Comment = '%1 = Current; %3 = Grand total';
        // recurs verbatim as the table field caption "Posting Date" in a different
        // context class (Codeunit|NamedType|Label vs. Table|Field|Caption)
        PostingDateLbl: Label 'Posting Date';
        // structurally identical sentence with the domain noun swapped: a glossary
        // term pair (Customer/Vendor) and a fuzzy-tier-3 near-duplicate at once
        CustomerNotFoundErr: Label 'Customer %1 not found.', Comment = '%1 = Customer No.';
        VendorNotFoundErr: Label 'Vendor %1 not found.', Comment = '%1 = Vendor No.';
        // second wave: reuses the exact source + context class (Codeunit|NamedType|Label)
        // of ReleaseStatusTxt above for a genuine tier-2 exact-reuse candidate
        ReleaseStatusAltTxt: Label 'Release';
        // second wave: reuses the exact source + context class of CustomerNotFoundErr
        // above, invoked from ShowCustomerNotFoundAgain
        CustomerNotFoundAltErr: Label 'Customer %1 not found.', Comment = '%1 = Customer No.';
}
